gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.21808 42.606947)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
slope_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(s.rast, 1, o.pt) AS slope_degrees
FROM slope_rast s, origin o;

WITH hospital_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.21808, 42.606947), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      r.rast,
      '32BF',
      true
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    hospital_geom h
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geography, h.geom)
),
slope_value AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(slope_rast, ST_Transform(h.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS slope_angle_deg
  FROM 
    slope_raster s,
    hospital_geom h
)
SELECT 
  slope_angle_deg
FROM 
  slope_value;
